segments.contextAfter: `identifier`: The string that identifies the segue to be performed. Using the Interface Builder inspector, provide a unique identifier string for each segue in a storyboard. The system provides a segue’s identifier to this parameter when it calls this method. The identifier string is used to locate the segue inside the storyboard file that contains the view controller. > **Note**:  This method throws an [`Exception handling`](https://developer.apple.comhttps://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/General/Conceptual/DevPedia-CocoaCore/ExceptionHandling.html#//apple_ref/doc/uid/TP40008195-CH18) if there is no segue with the specified identifier.
